faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know before starting your project.

items.q: How much does a website cost?
items.a: The price depends on project complexity. A showcase site starts from €800, an e-commerce from €2000. We provide a free detailed quote after our first consultation.
A showcase site is typically delivered in 2 to 4 weeks. A more complex project (app, e-commerce) takes 4 to 10 weeks depending on features. Timelines are defined and respected from signing.

items.q: Can I track my project's progress?
items.a: Yes — every client has a secure personal space where they can track progress in real time, see updates and communicate with the team.
Absolutely. We offer maintenance, hosting and technical support packages. We also train your teams on using the delivered tools.

items.q: Do you work with international clients?
items.a: Yes, we work with clients in France, Europe and internationally. All our communication can be done in French or English.

items.q: How does the first consultation work?
items.a: The first consultation is free and non-binding. We take the time to understand your needs, goals and budget before proposing an adapted solution.
